programs.notes: No programme-specific cut-off aggregate is published by SDD-UBIDS. The university's Admissions Requirements page states only the general bar - credit passes (A1-C6) in six subjects comprising three cores (including English Language and Mathematics) plus three relevant electives - and its admissions notice adds "Should have an aggregate score of 36 or better of the best six subjects (three core and three elective)". 36 is therefore the site-wide general ceiling, not a competitive departmental cut-off. No elective subjects are named for any individual programme (the requirement is "any three elective subjects ... among others"), so none are enforced.
